en.title: Singapore Airlines becomes first airline to buy SAF from Aether's Project Beacon
en.summary: Singapore Airlines has agreed to buy up to 4,800 tons of next-generation sustainable aviation fuel from Aether Fuels over three years, with deliveries from 2028, becoming the first airline to buy SAF from Aether's Project Beacon facility.
body: Under the agreement announced on October 28, 2026, Singapore Airlines will buy up to 4,800 tons of next-generation sustainable aviation fuel from Aether Fuels over three years, with deliveries starting in 2028. The deal makes Singapore Airlines the first airline to buy SAF from Project Beacon, Aether's first commercial production facility, located at the Pulau Bukom refining complex in Singapore. It is also Singapore Airlines' first purchase of SAF made with waste-carbon-to-jet-fuel technology, and it builds on a memorandum of understanding signed by the two sides in 2025.

Project Beacon will use biomethane and industrial waste gases as feedstocks and Aether's proprietary Aurora technology to produce SAF, using a Fischer-Tropsch-based process to convert waste gases into liquid aviation fuel. That offers an alternative to the hydroprocessed esters and fatty acids pathway, which accounts for most SAF production today but depends on limited lipid feedstocks such as used cooking oil and animal fats. The fuel will be certified under the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation, and Aether plans to scale up further, aiming to open its first large commercial plant by 2031 with at least 10 times Project Beacon's capacity. For Singapore Airlines, the agreement is part of its ambition to reach net zero carbon emissions by 2050.

zh.title: 新加坡航空向Aether購買最多4,800噸永續航空燃油、2028年起交付
zh.summary: 新加坡航空同意在3年內向Aether Fuels購買最多4,800噸新一代永續航空燃油，自2028年起交付，成為首家向Aether首座商業生產設施Project Beacon購買永續航空燃油的航空公司。
body: 這項於2026年10月28日公布的協議，讓新加坡航空成為首家向Project Beacon購買永續航空燃油的航空公司；Project Beacon是Aether Fuels的首座商業生產設施，位於新加坡毛廣島煉油綜合設施。這也是新加坡航空首次購買以廢碳轉化為噴射燃料技術製成的永續航空燃油，協議建立在雙方2025年簽署的合作備忘錄之上。

Project Beacon將以生物甲烷與工業廢氣等原料，透過Aether自有的Aurora技術生產永續航空燃油，製程以費托法為基礎，把廢氣轉化為液態航空燃料，提供氫化酯與脂肪酸路徑之外的替代方案；後者目前占大多數永續航空燃油生產，但依賴廢食用油與動物脂肪等供應有限的脂質原料。該燃料將依國際航空碳抵換及減量計畫認證；Aether計畫進一步擴大規模，目標在2031年前啟用首座大型商業工廠，產能至少為Project Beacon的10倍；對新加坡航空而言，這項協議是其2050年達成淨零碳排放目標的一部分。
